text: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
ir: (assert (e1 cancel :tense fut :subj (m1 we :pron) :obj (m2 picnic :det the) :condition (e2 rain :tense pres :subj (m3 it :pron :ref none) :adv tomorrow)))

text: We'll eat on the balcony if the evening stays warm.
ir: (assert (e1 eat :tense fut :subj (m1 we :pron) :obl-on (m2 balcony :det the) :condition (e2 stay :tense pres :subj (m3 evening :det the) :attr warm)))
notes: 'stay warm': copular verb, adjective as :attr (spec lists :attr only for be; most surface-faithful).

text: Unless you hurry, you will miss the last train.
ir: (assert (e1 miss :tense fut :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 train :det the :adj last) :unless (e2 hurry :tense pres :subj (m3 you :pron))))

text: I can't sleep unless the window is open.
ir: (assert (e1 sleep :pol neg :mod can :subj (m1 I :pron) :unless (e2 be :tense pres :subj (m2 window :det the) :attr open)))

text: If I had known about the party, I would have come.
ir: (assert (e1 come :aspect perf :mod would :subj (m1 I :pron) :condition (e2 know :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m2 I :pron) :obl-about (m3 party :det the))))

text: If we left now, we could catch the early bus.
ir: (assert (e1 catch :mod could :subj (m1 we :pron) :obj (m2 bus :det the :adj early) :condition (e2 leave :tense past :subj (m3 we :pron) :adv now)))
notes: Past-tense form with present/future meaning (remote conditional) is annotated as :tense past, surface-faithful.

text: Maria would buy the house if it had a garden.
ir: (assert (e1 buy :mod would :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :obj (m2 house :det the) :condition (e2 have :tense past :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m2) :obj (m4 garden :det a))))
notes: 'it': only singular non-human candidate is the house.

text: Because the road was icy, the driver went slowly.
ir: (assert (e1 go :tense past :subj (m1 driver :det the) :adv slowly :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m2 road :det the) :attr icy)))

text: The museum was closed, so we visited the park instead.
ir: (assert (e1 visit :tense past :subj (m1 we :pron) :obj (m2 park :det the) :adv instead :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 museum :det the) :attr closed)))
notes: 'X, so Y' = Y :cause X (§3). 'was closed' read as be + adjective :attr, not passive (stative).

text: Since you are tired, you should rest.
ir: (assert (e1 rest :mod should :subj (m1 you :pron) :cause (e2 be :tense pres :subj (m2 you :pron) :attr tired)))

text: Although the meal was expensive, everyone enjoyed it.
ir: (assert (e1 enjoy :tense past :subj (m1 everyone) :obj (m2 it :pron :ref m3) :concession (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 meal :det the) :attr expensive)))
notes: 'it' cannot be 'everyone' (human, and binding); only candidate is the meal.

text: Sam kept running even though his knee hurt.
ir: (assert (e1 keep :tense past :subj (m1 Sam :propn) :xcomp (e2 run) :concession (e3 hurt :tense past :subj (m2 knee :poss (m3 he :pron :ref m1)))))
notes: 'kept running': gerund complement annotated as :xcomp (spec only shows to-infinitives).

text: Though the shop was small, the owner sold excellent coffee.
ir: (assert (e1 sell :tense past :subj (m1 owner :det the) :obj (m2 coffee :adj excellent) :concession (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 shop :det the) :attr small)))

text: When the bell rang, the children ran outside.
ir: (assert (e1 run :tense past :subj (m1 child :det the :num pl) :adv outside :when (e2 ring :tense past :subj (m2 bell :det the))))

text: Call me when you arrive at the station.
ir: (command (e1 call :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 I :pron) :when (e2 arrive :tense pres :subj (m3 you :pron) :obl-at (m4 station :det the))))

text: Before the guests arrived, Tom cleaned the kitchen.
ir: (assert (e1 clean :tense past :subj (m1 Tom :propn) :obj (m2 kitchen :det the) :before (e2 arrive :tense past :subj (m3 guest :det the :num pl))))

text: We washed the dishes after we had eaten dinner.
ir: (assert (e1 wash :tense past :subj (m1 we :pron) :obj (m2 dish :det the :num pl) :after (e2 eat :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m3 we :pron) :obj (m4 dinner))))

text: While I was cooking, the phone rang twice.
ir: (assert (e1 ring :tense past :subj (m1 phone :det the) :adv twice :while (e2 cook :tense past :aspect prog :subj (m2 I :pron))))

text: Wait here until the doctor calls your name.
ir: (command (e1 wait :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :adv here :until (e2 call :tense pres :subj (m2 doctor :det the) :obj (m3 name :poss (m4 you :pron)))))

text: I saved money to buy a bicycle.
ir: (assert (e1 save :tense past :subj (m1 I :pron) :obj (m2 money) :purpose (e2 buy :obj (m3 bicycle :det a))))

text: Maria spoke slowly so that the students could understand her.
ir: (assert (e1 speak :tense past :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :adv slowly :purpose (e2 understand :mod could :subj (m2 student :det the :num pl) :obj (m3 she :pron :ref m1))))

text: To catch the early flight, we left the hotel at five.
ir: (assert (e1 leave :tense past :subj (m1 we :pron) :obj (m2 hotel :det the) :obl-at (m3 five) :purpose (e2 catch :obj (m4 flight :det the :adj early))))
notes: Clock time 'five' annotated as a bare mention head.

text: We opened the windows in order to cool the room.
ir: (assert (e1 open :tense past :subj (m1 we :pron) :obj (m2 window :det the :num pl) :purpose (e2 cool :obj (m3 room :det the))))

text: If you heat ice, it melts.
ir: (assert (e1 melt :tense pres :subj (m1 it :pron :ref m3) :condition (e2 heat :tense pres :subj (m2 you :pron) :obj (m3 ice))))

text: If the store is closed, I'll order the parts online.
ir: (assert (e1 order :tense fut :subj (m1 I :pron) :obj (m2 part :det the :num pl) :adv online :condition (e2 be :tense pres :subj (m3 store :det the) :attr closed)))

text: You won't pass the exam unless you study regularly.
ir: (assert (e1 pass :tense fut :pol neg :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 exam :det the) :unless (e2 study :tense pres :subj (m3 you :pron) :adv regularly)))

text: Because the printer was broken, Alex wrote the notes by hand.
ir: (assert (e1 write :tense past :subj (m1 Alex :propn) :obj (m2 note :det the :num pl) :obl-by (m3 hand) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m4 printer :det the) :attr broken)))

text: I stayed home because I felt sick.
ir: (assert (e1 stay :tense past :subj (m1 I :pron) :adv home :cause (e2 feel :tense past :subj (m2 I :pron) :attr sick)))

text: The flight was delayed because a storm hit the coast.
ir: (assert (e1 delay :tense past :voice pass :subj (m1 flight :det the) :cause (e2 hit :tense past :subj (m2 storm :det a) :obj (m3 coast :det the))))

text: Even though the film was long, the audience stayed until the end.
ir: (assert (e1 stay :tense past :subj (m1 audience :det the) :obl-until (m2 end :det the) :concession (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 film :det the) :attr long)))
notes: 'until the end' is a PP, not a clause relation: :obl-until.

text: The concert was canceled, so the fans got refunds.
ir: (assert (e1 get :tense past :subj (m1 fan :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 refund :num pl) :cause (e2 cancel :tense past :voice pass :subj (m3 concert :det the))))

text: When I was a child, I lived near the sea.
ir: (assert (e1 live :tense past :subj (m1 I :pron) :obl-near (m2 sea :det the) :when (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 I :pron) :attr (m4 child :det a))))

text: After the meeting ended, the manager sent everyone an email.
ir: (assert (e1 send :tense past :subj (m1 manager :det the) :obj (m3 email :det a) :iobj (m2 everyone) :after (e2 end :tense past :subj (m4 meeting :det the))))

text: If the bakery is open when we arrive, we will buy fresh bread.
ir: (assert (e1 buy :tense fut :subj (m1 we :pron) :obj (m2 bread :adj fresh) :condition (e2 be :tense pres :subj (m3 bakery :det the) :attr open :when (e3 arrive :tense pres :subj (m4 we :pron)))))
notes: 'when we arrive' attached inside the if-clause (closest clause); attachment to the main clause is also grammatical.

text: If you don't water the plants, they will die.
ir: (assert (e1 die :tense fut :subj (m1 they :pron :ref m3) :condition (e2 water :tense pres :pol neg :subj (m2 you :pron) :obj (m3 plant :det the :num pl))))

text: We couldn't hear the speaker because the room was noisy.
ir: (assert (e1 hear :pol neg :mod could :subj (m1 we :pron) :obj (m2 speaker :det the) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 room :det the) :attr noisy)))

text: Although I had set two alarms, I arrived late.
ir: (assert (e1 arrive :tense past :subj (m1 I :pron) :adv late :concession (e2 set :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m2 I :pron) :obj (m3 alarm :det two :num pl))))

text: Unless the weather improves, the match will be postponed.
ir: (assert (e1 postpone :tense fut :voice pass :subj (m1 match :det the) :unless (e2 improve :tense pres :subj (m2 weather :det the))))

text: Lock the door before you leave.
ir: (command (e1 lock :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 door :det the) :before (e2 leave :tense pres :subj (m3 you :pron))))

text: I would have helped you if you had asked me.
ir: (assert (e1 help :aspect perf :mod would :subj (m1 I :pron) :obj (m2 you :pron) :condition (e2 ask :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m3 you :pron) :obj (m4 I :pron))))

text: If Robin had taken the train, she would not have missed the wedding.
ir: (assert (e1 miss :aspect perf :pol neg :mod would :subj (m1 she :pron :ref m2) :obj (m3 wedding :det the) :condition (e2 take :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m2 Robin :propn) :obj (m4 train :det the))))
notes: Robin has unknown gender, so 'she' can refer to Robin.

text: The kids played outside until it got dark.
ir: (assert (e1 play :tense past :subj (m1 kid :det the :num pl) :adv outside :until (e2 get :tense past :subj (m2 it :pron :ref none) :attr dark)))

text: While the paint dries, don't touch the door.
ir: (command (e1 touch :pol neg :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 door :det the) :while (e2 dry :tense pres :subj (m3 paint :det the))))

text: She left early so that she could avoid the traffic.
ir: (assert (e1 leave :tense past :subj (m1 she :pron :ref none) :adv early :purpose (e2 avoid :mod could :subj (m2 she :pron :ref none) :obj (m3 traffic :det the))))
notes: Pronoun-to-pronoun links are not represented in v0 (IR-v0 §9); both pronouns have :ref none.

text: We moved to the city to find work.
ir: (assert (e1 move :tense past :subj (m1 we :pron) :obl-to (m2 city :det the) :purpose (e2 find :obj (m3 work))))

text: Although the test was difficult, most students passed because they had prepared well.
ir: (assert (e1 pass :tense past :subj (m1 student :det most :num pl) :concession (e2 be :tense past :subj (m2 test :det the) :attr difficult) :cause (e3 prepare :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m3 they :pron :ref m1) :adv well)))
notes: 'most' used as :det (not in the spec's det list, but it is a determiner). 'they': only plural candidate is the students.

text: If you see Maria before the party starts, tell her the plan.
ir: (command (e1 tell :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :iobj (m2 she :pron :ref m4) :obj (m3 plan :det the) :condition (e2 see :tense pres :subj (m5 you :pron) :obj (m4 Maria :propn) :before (e3 start :tense pres :subj (m6 party :det the)))))
notes: 'before the party starts' attached inside the if-clause; main-clause attachment also possible.

text: If the bus had come on time, I could have finished the report.
ir: (assert (e1 finish :aspect perf :mod could :subj (m1 I :pron) :obj (m2 report :det the) :condition (e2 come :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m3 bus :det the) :obl-on (m4 time))))

text: Since the library closes at six, we should leave soon.
ir: (assert (e1 leave :mod should :subj (m1 we :pron) :adv soon :cause (e2 close :tense pres :subj (m2 library :det the) :obl-at (m3 six))))

text: Tom smiled when he saw the results, but he didn't say anything.
ir: (assert (but (e1 smile :tense past :subj (m1 Tom :propn) :when (e2 see :tense past :subj (m2 he :pron :ref m1) :obj (m3 result :det the :num pl))) (e3 say :tense past :pol neg :subj (m4 he :pron :ref m1) :obj (m5 anything))))
notes: Both pronouns: Tom is the only masculine-compatible candidate.
